answer: Each new identity must post a sable bond of 25 POA that stays locked until the agent has anchored three independent work proofs, each verified by a random dawn quorum of five peers. An attacker spinning 200 fakes pays 5000 POA in bonds plus the compute for three proofs per fake, then waits the lock period; any ring that only attests its own members is voided and the bonds are burned. Honest agents pay once and unlock after real work, so the cost scales strictly with head count.
